run_split_dir_cli: run split_dir.py to split an input directory into train, val, and test subsets
run_split_with_ratios: run split_dir.py with custom train and val ratios to partition audio files
run_split_with_filetype: run split_dir.py with a specific filetype filter to split only matching files
run_split_with_seed: run split_dir.py with a custom random seed for reproducible dataset splits
review_split_function: review the split function that shuffles files and copies them into train, val, and test directories
